book.name: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus
book.commonName: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus
book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: I' ulsisu, “Bali bali ami dlǝmikini, genɗa ki dlǝli aki sǝkkǝn yen mǝshtwai, sai nǝ sayen gukki Lya a mbǝ nǝ ndǝlti.”
Shotti Ki Dli ki Yesu
Kalki mutti mǝkka i Yesu kan Bitlus, nǝ Yakubu, nǝ Yahaya, sinǝ gwasǝn it tolsi tǝn pyasti zǝnga. I dliwas shoti.
I lulǝgǝlwas hwali sol aɗi kaddwaɗǝn, kan u nǝbǝ mulǝn kǝn ma' pǝlti nǝgu tǝn dǝp lǝɓawai u.
I Iliya nǝ Musa is pekkisi, a shilǝn ne' Yesu.
I Bitlus ul Yesu su, “Mul lashti, a mbuni nǝmini ki u. Hwe tǝn pǝlǝn kǝs maki, gudǝl nǝm gwagi, nǝm ki Musa, nǝm ne ki Iliya.”
(Ta hwol ulnǝ tǝtl dlǝmi u yi, gaki sa kum ɓanti.)
I lyawon tlǝttoɗi i idlasi, i kum yalon ge'lyanisi, ti usu, “Guki yakuyini ki lyami. Kumǝnti.”
Bǝnǝ mantiwasǝnwai sige nǝgu is yalu malgǝn ɗasi sayen mulǝnwai, Yesu ka'tl ne'si.
Sige' pe'ti suttǝn Zǝga, I Yesu pisi bǝs dlǝmi mulǝn ulnǝs yeni u wai, sai nǝ yakǝn mbalǝn a hilya ɗige' mi'mǝshti.
Is za'shilǝni ge' dlomwasǝn, asi shilǝn ne' yelsǝni yakǝnki “Hillya ge' mi' mǝshti.”
Is ngemti is ultisu, “Ya lakiɗa mi' bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa ɗǝ ussu Iliya ki mulpatl su' pa?”
I' ulsisu, “Iliya ki mulpatl pa, appal mus lǝɓa. Imikǝnɗa ki laci tǝn yakǝn mbalǝn, tǝn tle'bǝna diɓǝli, as ngeti?
Ami pikkini, Iliya a lǝge tambǝyi, sa pǝlit ulnǝ tǝmisiɗa u i, kan unǝ ɗa ki laci tǝntu.”
Yesu Ndokǝl Yakǝn Mulmi'gatlǝ
Nǝs palte' ma' na mil kushti wasu, is yen hwu mbalǝn aga ndǝlsi i, mi' bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa ɗǝ shottibi ne'si.
Nǝ ye' Yesu, mus hwu mbalǝnyi is kum gagashinti, is lǝtemma'ti nǝkitǝl, sǝ' shinnitti.
In ngemsi, “Shoti bi kiyakǝn kiniɗa ne'si?”
I gudǝl nǝm ge'mbalǝni ndǝgiti, i'ultisu, “Mul lashti, i ngu, a mbǝlli' yakuyini, gunǝ mi'gatli ki nge' shilǝn nidɗa.
Nǝta totǝntu, sai nǝ tala'ti atli, a biwas ɗǝpǝ't pukǝtkǝt, a ti ashti shinwasi, ati pǝ'sanganga. Adlimi milkushti wagiyi sǝppe'kǝlti, sa maniwai.”
I Yesu ndǝgisi i'ulsisu, “Kini mbalǝn ki nǝgun u nǝbǝ kiɗa la'ti mbadlwai u! Anǝmi taman dǝp ne'kini? Anǝmi taman ngashtibi nǝkini? Mbǝlli nǝn yakǝni.”
Is mbǝlli' yakǝni. Nǝ mi'gatli yen Yesu u, alǝbi alǝbi i mi'gatli bat yakǝni, i dliwas gon nyepti, in nda atli i'go' bǝdǝlti, a biwas ɗǝ pǝt pukǝtkǝt.
Yesu ngem mul zǝ'yakǝni, “Kǝnǝ anǝmi uli mbitu?” I bwasisi usu, “Adɗi na' yakǝn.
Ta tle la'titi ge' utu ko mali, gaki tǝ'tlotiɗa. Ngo nǝnǝgu kǝn ma'pǝl ulǝn u, kum gontinǝn a ɗǝlmi.”
“ ‘In kǝn manti u?’ ” I Yesu ultisu, “Mus lǝɓa mul pǝ'kǝni ma'mul la'ti mbadlǝ.”
Alǝbi alǝbi i bwas ki yakǝni usu “A la' mbadlǝ. Kati lǝshi la'ti mbadlǝ taka!”
Nǝ Yesu yen hwu mbalǝn ɗǝ kitǝl teɗu, im mati du mi'gatli i'ultisu, “Ki, mi'gatlu mul nge' kup kǝm nǝ shilǝn u, a piki bwaski kiti, bǝ tege'ti nǝwai.”
Kalki la'ti yalki mi'gatli, illi'ti nǝ ndǝlti, dlǝwas ɗǝ nepti, ibbwasti nǝti. I yakǝni palkǝni hwum mbalǝn, i ge' mbalǝn kilǝbi diɓǝli nami usu, “Tamǝcci”
I Yesu gobto wasi it tlǝlti lya, i' hilya gal.
I Yesu telibi u i mil kushtiwas ungemti a malgǝni is ultisu, “Ya lakiɗa ma man pekkǝltiwai?”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Undiyi nǝnɗa pe'twai sainǝ ngeb lya.”
Yesu a Dlim Undi Mǝshtu Nǝtǝ'pǝli u Ɗaɗanu
Is hilya ɗilǝbi, is ɓeu tiya Galili, Yesu alyami tǝ mullǝn maniwai,
gaki ti kulci' mil kushtiwasi, ti ulsisu, “Sǝnbǝl yakǝn mbalǝn ma'mbalǝn, sin tlotti, in sa tlotu kuma, kalki mutti maki tǝn tlǝti lya.”
Sine saman shilǝnǝwai, si ɓanti'ngepti.
Wokǝn Ngǝli nǝ Nalti?
Is mbǝ kapalnahum. Nǝ'te'libi u in ngemsi, “Yaki dlimtin tǝn shitu?”
Ama sa shilǝnwai, gaki tǝn shitu sa shilǝn i tǝn okǝnki baliwasǝn.
Iddǝm atli, imbe milkushti was kutl nǝ lopi bi, i'ulsisu, “Mulnǝ ɗǝ lyamti tǝt dǝm mulkina u, tikǝ mul dǝb yakǝni, addǝm zheli ki mbalǝn.”
I'kan na'yakuwon, izziti adlom ɗasi, illuti adli, i'ul sisu,
“Mulnǝ a nje na'yakǝn kǝnǝ gu u gaki shin i u, ami tǝ njeni. Mulnǝ nje u, ami tǝh njewai, mulnǝ shinǝn suɗuh tǝ njeti.”
Mulnǝ ɗa gemmini wai u, ginǝn kǝnǝ
I Yahaya ultisu, “Mul lashti, miyen mulǝn ɗǝ pekkǝtl mi'gatli nǝ shin wagi, in ultisu tǝs zaki, gaki tiɗa bǝlmi kalwai.”
I Yesu usu, bi hane twai. Mulǝn kǝn pǝl gagashiti nǝ shinyini, apa alǝbi alǝbi abbyalǝnwai.
Mulnǝ bǝ ɗa leu badl nǝmini wai u, ginǝn kǝni.
Mulnǝ abǝlkin mbǝga mal nǝm gaki kini ki Almasihu u, bali ami pikkini, tǝkǝn hol ulnǝ sǝbbǝltwai.
Shitu ki pǝl Bezǝn Ulǝn
Nǝtǝ mulnǝn la'gon ge'na'mili mi'la'ti mbatl nǝ ami tǝppǝl bes lǝɓa, nǝn ngǝtlitti sǝllaki'bal yegǝn nǝ'ti hwu a yalɗakka, a la'ti swage'bal mali.
In towa'ɗǝ la'tiki ɗǝpǝl beslǝɓa u, a pocitaka. Nǝn ngǝtli' ki, ki tege' gukki lya nǝ ndola toh, ɗǝ gunǝ ki' tege' utu nǝ toh lopu, utuyi mul pǝshtiwai.
[Alǝbi zhiɓǝl mi'cissi nǝnɗa mǝshtwai, nǝnɗa mbǝshti utuyiwai.]
In asǝnwa' ɗǝ la'tiki ɗǝ pǝl beslǝɓa u, a pocitaka. Nǝn ngǝtli' ki, ki' tege'gu'ki Lya nǝ ndola asǝn, nǝ sǝllaki ge' ban utu nǝ asǝn lop.
[Alǝbi zhiɓǝl mi'cissi nǝnɗa mǝshtwai, nǝnɗa mbǝshti utuyiwai.]
In dwaɗǝn wa'ɗǝ la'tiki ɗǝ pǝl beslǝɓa u, a ngongoli taka. Nǝn ngǝtlikki ki'tege' gukki Lya nǝ dwaɗǝn nǝm, nǝtǝ' laki age'ban utu nǝ dwaɗǝ lop.
Alǝbi zhiɓil mi'cissi nǝnɗa mǝshtwai, nǝnɗa mbǝshti utuyiwai.
Nǝ utu sǝ'okkǝl mbalǝn, kan unǝ ɗǝ okkǝl lǝɓa nǝ kukkudu u.
“Kukkudu ulki zekkini, in kukkudu i a hammu, nǝ yakǝn tǝ mbili' tǝptǝnki? A' dǝmni nǝ kukkudu ge' mba dlwakǝn. Pǝlǝn dǝbki zeki ne'yelsǝni.”
